name: Transvoxel Transition Face Generation
definition: A method to generate mesh geometry at the boundary between two levels of detail (LOD) in a voxel grid, specifically creating a transition face to bridge the gap between a coarse LOD (LOD > 0) and the finest LOD (LOD 0).
summary: Transvoxel Transition Face Generation creates manifold mesh geometry at the boundary between different levels of detail in a voxel grid, bridging gaps between coarse and fine resolutions to prevent holes.
